colon-paths-only-post.description: Paths containing a colon must only use POST operations.

discriminator-example.description: Schemas with a discriminator must define an example to work around Swagger UI issue #8336.
discriminator-example.message: Schema with discriminator must define at least one example. As work around for Swagger UI issue #8336.

get-put-same-schema.description: GET responses and PUT request bodies on the same path should use the same schema.

no-anonymous-object-schemas.description: Object schemas should be named components and referenced with $ref.

unused-component-except-partial.description: Component schemas should be referenced. Partial schemas may be unused when their non-prefixed partner exists.
